verdict.rationale: Docs reference concrete OpenAPI YAML files (e.g. openapi/compliance.yaml, openapi/gateway.yaml), showing Circle does publish machine-readable specs for at least some API surfaces, and llms.txt is also machine-readable. However a probe for standard top-level openapi.json/swagger.json endpoints returned 404s, suggesting no single unified, easily discoverable spec covering the whole API. Missing for 10: a consolidated top-level OpenAPI spec download, and independent confirmation that all API products (not just compliance/gateway) are covered.
